item.title: Leading from Anywhere: The Essential Guide to Managing Remote Teams
item.description:
Leading from Anywhere: The Essential Guide to Managing Remote Teams

Summary

“Leading from Anywhere: The Essential Guide to Managing Remote Teams” by David Burkus is a comprehensive guide that addresses the challenges and opportunities of managing remote teams effectively. The book provides insights on how to build culture remotely, maintain productivity, and ensure team cohesion despite geographical distances. Burkus explores various aspects of remote leadership, from hiring and onboarding new team members to maintaining effective communication and cultivating trust. The book is grounded in research and real-world examples, making it a practical resource for anyone leading or participating in remote work setups.

item.title: Digital Body Language: How to Build Trust and Connection, No Matter the Distance
item.description:
Digital Body Language: How to Build Trust and Connection, No Matter the Distance

Summary

“Digital Body Language” by Erica Dhawan explores the nuances of communication in the digital age, where traditional face-to-face interactions are often replaced by emails, texts, and virtual meetings. The book delves into how digital communication can often lead to misunderstandings due to the lack of nonverbal cues and body language. Dhawan emphasizes the importance of understanding these new forms of “digital body language” to foster clearer and more effective communication. Through anecdotes, research, and practical advice, she illustrates how to convey tone, build trust, and communicate intentions effectively in virtual spaces.
